paragraphs: Mentioned in a baraita in Sanhedrin 53; see the entry R' Yochanan ben Shaul.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied כסנהדרין נג, has kaf and comma. In Sanhedrin is a contextual reading of that anomalous prefix; no Hebrew repair is made and no amud is added. No named edition is independently checked.

ב״ש is completed as ben Shaul from the exact full patronymic in this same notice. Yonatan and Yochanan remain different supplied given names, and the pointer is not identity admission. Both title abbreviations remain R'.
